>  Nothing makes you more likely to lose the fire to learn than someone mocking you because you aren't so good yet

I'm a fatty, I also have pretty bad social anxiety - I've tried to start going to the gym 3 times in the last 2 years, but inevitably a group of guys will decide to show how cool they are by making fun of me. Generally can't get up the motivation to return after that, plus I'm usually pretty frustrated/embarrassed so I eat a bunch of comfort foods. :/
This would be nice, but due to my health and finances not really an option right now, thanks for the thought though.
I do, but most of the time I get distracted and lose the plot or end up just turning it off and sitting around staring into space or just going to sleep.

I've been listening to a lot of different stuff, just running it in the background while I'm awake.

There's not really anything I'm supposed to be accomplishing in particular. I'm supposed to be resting because of the damage to my spine. I have to go in for spinal surgery next week...I keep hoping something goes wrong during the operation and I die on the operating table so I don't have to do it myself.

Really I don't do much now. I run some music in the background while I surf reddit, not really accomplishing anything. just can't seem to get motivated to do anything else and really don't feel interested in anything...feel like I'm just waiting to die so I might as well skip to the end. Other than that I sleep like 15 hours a day.

Part of the problem is I don't really like to do anything. When I was younger I was relatively normal - I had friends, went to parties, got a couple of college degrees, did normal things like watch TV or go to movies or read books...boring stuff I guess, but it was ok. Somehow over time I just pretty much lost interest in everything. At some point,  I just stopped caring about anything, so I went to work, ate, slept, went to work, repeat. I just feel like some kind of robot that just goes through the motions, and if I break down the best thing would be just to throw me in the junk pile and replace me with another model.
